accepted_steps.derivation: Let S_k=(R_k,B_k,G_k) be the urn after k rounds. The initial state is S_0=(3,2,1), since the urn begins with 3 red, 2 blue, and 1 green ball; hence N_0=3+2+1=6. For any state S=(r,b,g) reached during the six rounds, let N=r+b+g. Since draws are uniform over the current urn, the conditional draw probabilities are P(red | S)=r/N, P(blue | S)=b/N, and P(green | S)=g/N. The update rule from a red draw returns the red ball and adds one blue ball, so r is unchanged, b increases by 1, and g is unchanged: (r,b,g)->(r,b+1,g). The update rule from a blue draw removes that blue ball and adds one green ball, so r is unchanged, b decreases by 1, and g increases by 1: (r,b,g)->(r,b-1,g+1), with this transition available only when b>0. The update rule from a green draw returns the green ball and adds one red ball, so r increases by 1, b is unchanged, and g is unchanged: (r,b,g)->(r+1,b,g). The total becomes N+1 after red or green, and remains N after blue, since blue is replaced by green. This step fixes notation and the one-round transition kernel; it does not evaluate six-round probabilities.
accepted_steps.goal: Define state (r,b,g), total n, draw probabilities r/n, b/n, g/n, and the one-round update maps; record the initial state (3,2,1).
accepted_steps.result: State S=(r,b,g); initial S0=(3,2,1). One-round transitions: red with probability r/(r+b+g) to (r,b+1,g); blue with probability b/(r+b+g) to (r,b-1,g+1); green with probability g/(r+b+g) to (r+1,b,g).

decomposition_plan.goal: Define state (r,b,g), total n, draw probabilities r/n, b/n, g/n, and the one-round update maps; record the initial state (3,2,1).
Set up an exact recurrence for P_k(r,b,g), the probability of being in state (r,b,g) after k updates, with P_0(3,2,1)=1.
Compute exact rational probabilities P_1 through P_6 by applying the recurrence and transition maps from P_0.
Identify every final state with maximal P_6 and report the modal (red,blue,green) with its exact probability.
Compute P(sixth draw is red) as the sum over states after five updates of P_5(r,b,g)*r/(r+b+g).
Report the modal final state, its exact probability, and the exact probability that the sixth draw is red.
